name: The Grand Alliance
author: Mihail-Enoh Bodnarciuc
description:
**The Grand Alliance** is a massive overhaul expansion for **Heroes of Might and Magic III**. This project represents a colossal transformation of the classic experience, expanding the strategic boundaries of the game by integrating new content, being a combination of multiple **famous mods**.

## Expanding the World

In addition to the classic factions, this overhaul brings together popular towns to conquer, so you can choose between **14 distinct factions**. The additions are:

- **Cove:** A pirate-themed Regnan town mastering the seas with marine creatures and naval **cannons**. Originally from the Horn of the Abyss (HotA) expansion.
- **Factory:** A technological powerhouse featuring mechanics, firearms and artificial constructs. Originally from the Horn of the Abyss (HotA) expansion.
- **Bulwark:** A frozen haven of ancient traditions, Snow Elves and frostland beasts. Originally from the Horn of the Abyss (HotA) expansion.
- **Highlands:** A rugged mountain fortress tied to nature, endurance and ancient traditions, that has its own war machine, the **armored cannon**. Taken from the Highlands Town Mod.
- **Forge:** A relentless city of technology bringing devastating mechanical warfare to the battlefield. A combination of the Forge Mod made by MDT with a touch of the Forge2k Mod.

## New Creatures

The core addition of this pack is a fundamental restructuring of the army sizes. Every faction in the game (except for the **Cove**) now commands **8 distinct troops**.

### Double Tier 7

Each town benefits from two independent Tier 7 creatures and both of their dwellings can be built simultaneously in the same town. The creatures are taken from Tides of War, Highlands-Town, Forge and Forge2k. The new creatures are:

- **Castle: Templar/Paladin.** A fierce but quite slow fighter that hates the undead more than anything. It can cast a very powerful **Destroy Undead** spell and it also grants **luck** to the entire army!
- **Tower: Drake/Dragon Golems.** Huge mechanical dragons that like to **strike first** against the enemy. Try not to mess with them, because one **retaliation attack** is not enough!
- **Inferno: Succubus/Abyssal Succubus.** A ranged demoness whose ranged attack **reduces enemy troops' attack and defense** by 1 (non-stackable). A perfect counter to gunslingers, she does not allow troops to **retaliate from range**. Only she does!
- **Stronghold: Brass Couatl/Quetzalcouatl.** A fierce flying unit that has immunity to **almost all spells** that triggered after other creatures attack.
- **Conflux: Triton/Abyssal Triton.** A melee control unit. The Abyssal Titon has the special ability **Trawl** that makes an enemy unit **stuck in place** and can be casted **twice**!
- **Cove:** The only faction that does not have 8 units; its only T7 creature is the **Sea Serpent/Haspid**, but taking advantage of the unit’s **Revenge** ability and to keep balance with the other 13 factions, they now have **double growth**.
- **Bulwark: Snow Witch/Ice Sorceress.** A fast melee unit that can use **the new rune artifacts** and can **freeze** enemy troops after attacking.
- **Factory:** Already has 8 creatures, but they are **boosted** to compete with the other factions. A major change can be seen in **Couatl/Crimson Couatl’s Meditation** ability, making it cast **without** skipping its turn and it can be cast **once/twice**!
- **Highlands:** Already has 8 creatures, now **rebalanced** to fit the pack.
- **Forge:** Besides the 7 creatures from MDT’s Forge, I added the Juggernaut/Dreadnought from Forge2k Mod and renamed it Annihilator/Terminator. The other creatures and structures got small rebalance changes in names, functionality and **stats**.

These factions get a new unit, though not a T7, so I rearranged the tiers of each unit like this:

- **Rampart:**
  - T4: **Dryad/Oak Dryad.** A new flying support unit that can **revive** Dendroids.
  - T5: **Pegasus/Silver Pegasus.** A flying unit that makes the enemy hero pay more **spell points** for each spell cast in combat.
  - T6: **Dendroid Guard/Soldier.** A strong but slow melee fighter that **bind** the enemy in place.
  - T7: **Unicorn/War Unicorn.** A fast melee unit that can **blind** the enemy after attacking and has **spell immunity** to lvl 1 & 2 spells. It also provides an **aura of magic resistance** to adjacent troops.
  - T7: **Green/Gold Dragon.**
- **Necropolis:**
  - T6: **Werewolf/Dire Werewolf.** A strong offensive permanently affected by rage/dire rage: in combat, it gains **+1 (+2) attack and defense** each turn, which stacks until the end of the fight.
  - T7: **Black/Dread Knights.** A fast melee unit that can deal **double** damage and **curse** the enemy.
  - T7: **Bone/Ghost Dragon.** Rebalanced.
- **Dungeon:**
  - T5: **Illithid/Alhoon.** A slow melee fighter that can cast **hypnosis** on enemy troops.
  - T6: **Minotaur/Minotaur King.** A strong melee unit that always has positive morale and grants a **+1/+2 morale boost** to himself.
  - T7: **Manticore/Scorpicore.** A fast flying unit that can **paralyze** the enemy.
  - T7: **Red/Black Dragon.**
- **Fortress:**
  - T6: **Troll Hag/Witch.** A ranged **regenerating** unit that can **slow** enemy troops.
  - T7: **Wyvern/Wyvern Monarch.** A fast flying unit that can **poison** the enemy.
  - T7: **Hydra/Chaos Hydra.** Rebalanced.

### More Neutral Creatures

Brand new neutral troops have been added from multiple mods (HotA, Highlands, Forge, Tides of War).

## New Spells

- **Divine Arrows (Air Magic):** A **lvl 3** spell that gives **extra shots** and removes **any ranged penalty** until the end of the battle.
- **Vitality (Water Magic):** A **lvl 5** spell that increases the **maximum health** of all living friendly troops.

## New Secondary Skills

- **Hexes and Intimidation:** Added **Hexes** (the exact opposite of Luck, reducing enemy luck) and **Intimidation** (the opposite of Leadership, reducing enemy morale).
- **Runes and Interference:** From the HotA expansion. **Runes** is exclusive to Bulwark and Highlands towns and can be learned by all heroes from these two factions or by any hero with Scholar. **Interference** lowers the spell power of the enemy hero.
- **Resistance Returns:** The classic **Resistance** skill is re-enabled for use.
- **Balance Changes:** Skills like **Eagle Eye** and **Learning** had some changes to be more competitive with others.
- **More Skills:** Heroes can now learn up to **10 Secondary Skills**.

## New Heroes

A variety of **new heroes** have been added to lead your forces:

- **Heroes with Speed specialty:** Andres (Warlock)
- **Heroes with Creature specialty:**
  - **Castle:** Charles (Knight) – Templars/Paladins, Michael (Cleric) – Angels/Archangels
  - **Rampart:** Eurydis (Ranger) – Dryads/Oak Dryads, Ghuri (Druid) – Green/Gold Dragons
  - **Tower:** Primus (Alchemist) – Giants/Titans, Verstan (Wizard) – Drake/Dragon Golems
  - **Inferno:** Eyzea (Demoniac) – Succubus/Abyssal Succubus, Kreevion (Heretic) – Devils/Arch Devils
  - **Necropolis:** Yaverr (Death Knight) – Werewolves/Dire Werewolves, Zam (Necromancer) – Bone/Ghost Dragons
  - **Dungeon:** Galuum (Warlock) – Illithids/Alhoons, Daxaroth (Overlord) – Red/Black Dragons, Collivea (Overlord) – Medusas/Medusa Queens
  - **Stronghold:** Ergon (Barbarian) – Brass Couatls/Quetzalcouatls, Tartarr (Battle Mage) – Behemoths/Ancient Behemoths
  - **Fortress:** Shroo (Witch) – Troll Hags/Troll Witches, Thyroc (Beastmaster) – Hydras/Chaos Hydras
  - **Conflux:** (Old Conflux heroes with creature specialties now grant 20% for every x levels, where x is the creature's tier): Irrigus (Elementalist) – Tritons/Abyssal Tritons, Helios (Elementalist) – Firebirds/Phoenixes, Zephyr (Planeswalker) & Vortis (Planeswalker) – Air Elementals
  - **Cove:** Skar (Captain) – Nix/Nix Warriors, Alma (Navigator) – Sea Serpents/Haspids
  - **Factory:** Mosadino (Mercenary) – Couatls/Crimson Couatls, Tudor (Artificer) – Dreadnoughts/Juggernauts
  - **Bulwark:** Valgard (Chieftain) – Jotunns/Jotunn Warlords, Sylphine (Elder) – Snow Witches/Ice Sorceresses
  - **Forge:** No new faces, but changed specialties of existing heroes.
  - **Highlands:** Thorin (Warlord) – Fire/Magma Dragons, Brynhildr (Pyromancer) – Amazons/Valkyries

## New Artifacts

Several new artifacts have been introduced to complement the new abilities and strategic playstyles:

- **HotA Artifacts**
- **Sword Breaker:** A relic that reduces the combat speed, attack and defense of **all** enemy units.
- **Third Eye** A combined major artifact assembled from the **Stoic Watchman**, **Bird** **of** **Perception** and **Emblem of Cognizance**. Increases spell learning chance up to **100%** and maximum spell level up to **5th level.** 
- **Binoculars:** A combined major artifact assembled from the **Pendant of Second Sight**, **Speculum** and **Spyglass**. The hero is permanently under the **Vision** spell and gains **+4 sight radius**.
- **New Runes and Runestone Shops** (Highlands & Bulwark):
  - **Rune of Charge:** Increases the **speed** of any friendly unit.
  - **Rune of Resistance:** Reduces **magic damage taken** by any friendly unit.
  - **Rune of Cure:** Dispels **negative effects** on a selected friendly unit.
  - **Rune of Swift:** Increases the **number of attacks** by one for any friendly unit. Requires **Adv. Runes**.
  - **Rune of Rage:** Increases the **damage** of any friendly unit. Requires **Adv. Runes.**
  - **Rune of Etherealness:** Increases the **defense** of any friendly unit. Requires **Adv. Runes.**
  - **Rune of Dragonform:** Increases the **attack and defense** stats of any friendly unit and grants **immunity to all spell damage**. Requires **Adv. Runes**.
  - **Rune of Resurrection:** **Resurrects** fallen troops (excluding war machines, mechanical units, golems and undead). Only **Exp. Runes** allows keeping the resurrected troops after the battle.

## Credits and Acknowledgements

To be completely clear: I did NOT create any of the original sprites or graphical assets used in this pack. The vast majority of the images, portraits, and sprites are taken directly from other existing mods and their respective creators.

Here is the exact breakdown of what was actually made/custom-created by me:
- Arrow tower icons for all 9 original factions.
- All heroes that are not part of the standard/ported factions (HoTA, Highlands, Forge, Core game).
- The 'Astral Spire' building for the Bulwark town.

Everything else (sprites, creature animations, etc.) belongs entirely to the amazing Heroes 3 modding community and the initial creators of those respective mods. All I did was adapt, integrate, and modify the code to make them work together in this unified pack.

While the 8-troop architecture and Double Tier 7 system is an original design shift, all rights for the original assets belong to their initial creators.

**Credits & Special Thanks:**
- **VCMI Team** for the engine, visual refinements, and base factions.
- The creators of **The Great Expansion**, **Highlands**, **Forge**, **Forge2k**, **Tides of War** and **HotA Team** for their extraordinary models, art, and vision.
